construction.native_reference: K=M0-E0 I, retaining all8 native levels
construction.spatial_mode: one declared positive three-dimensional harmonic-profile mode
construction.uniform_lapse_derivative_identity: d/ds [exp(s+F_x Q)K_x] at s0 = exp(F_x Q)K_x >=0

weak_source_Newton_coefficient: 1/(4 pi kappa), with lattice/boundary and small-source errors retained
